course.title: Express.js — Complete Practical Backend API Course
course.description: A deep practical Express.js course from server fundamentals through routing, middleware, validation, REST APIs, authentication, security, testing, architecture and production learning-platform projects.
learningOutcomes: Secure APIs with CORS, headers and rate limiting.
Build course, enrollment, progress and submission APIs.

lessons.title: What Is Express.js?
lessons.description: Understand Express as a Node.js web framework and learn how it simplifies HTTP APIs, routing and middleware.
learningObjectives: Apply it to a realistic production API.

notes.text: What Is Express.js?
Understand Express as a Node.js web framework and learn how it simplifies HTTP APIs, routing and middleware.

notes.caption: Visual explanation of What Is Express.js?.

notes.text: Study Method

notes.title: Express Tip
notes.text: Keep routing, controllers, business logic, validation and data access separated. This makes the API easier to test and scale.

notes.title: Common Mistake
notes.text: Never trust req.body, req.params or req.query. Validate external input and never expose internal error details or secrets to clients.

Build the API layer for a realistic education platform. Course content may come from dedicated JSON files or a database, while student-specific data such as enrollment, progress and submissions is handled through secure Express APIs.
